title: A proof of the $4,7$ cases of Sylvester's conjecture on cube sums
summary: In this paper, we prove that every prime $p$ which is congruent to $4,7$ modulo $9$ is the sum of two rational cubes. This is $2/3$ of Sylvester's conjecture which has a history of nearly 150 years since 1879. In the proof, we use recent progress on Full BSD conjecture of rank $0$ elliptic curves in \cite{BF} to deduce that the Manin-Stevens constants of some families of elliptic curves are units.
